name: Kidou Nagisa
source:
A person who is forced to participate in the game. She is an airhead who's personality and appearance makes her stand out.

[spoiler]In fact she is one of Game masters — former players, who was hired by game organizers to serve as moles and "spice" the Game from the inside.

Assigned PDA card: Jack[/spoiler]
